tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur mgon lha brgyad kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i gtum drag me 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka badz+ra ma hā ka la ye/ 'dir mgon po lha brgyad kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg bya tshul bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab kyi snying po bsdus nas sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab sras kyi phyag len la mdzad pa'i dbyangs rol 'chams sogs 'jug tshul phyogs gcig tu bkod na/ mdos dang gtor ma sogs dang sbrel nas bya tshul dang / sbyin sreg rkyang pa bya tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mdos gtor gang yin kyang sang 'phen rgyu'i do nub bya dgos pas/ spyi btab kyi sngon du gnas de nyid dam/ de dang ha cang mi ring ba'i phyogs zhig tu sbyin sreg 'di byas la spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ drug cu pa sogs gtor bzlog yin na zor gtor rnams kyi/ mdun bskyed kyi drung du snod 'bru nag gis bkang ba la spos gtsug las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum phul/ kha ras lag lcibs dang bcas pas snod slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis spos rtse nas cung zad btog 'bru phran bu dang bcas pa thab nang du gtor nas spos lhag snod dang bcas pa thab drung du bzhag ye shes pa gshegs gsol gyi tshe/ spos sbar la las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phyag gsum phul/ snod bcas blang nas mdun bskyed la 'bru nag cung zad gtor/ snod sngar shul du bzhag dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod nas phyir byas tshe nang du log la gtor 'bul sogs gong gi 'phros rnams bya'o/ /gnyis pa sbyin sreg rkyang pa bya tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sar khrag dang btsag bsres pa'i thig chen brgyad btab la chos 'byung nag po gru gsum kha khyer ljang khu la rdo rje nag po rwa gdengs pa dang me ris kyis bskor ba bris pa'i dbus/ pad nyi ro gdan la gri gug nag po 'bri ba'am/

yang na 'bru sogs sam rdul tshon nag po'i tshon spungs bkod pa'i khar mañja'i steng du lcags slang sogs snod chen po'i nang tsher ma can gyi shing la khrag dang snum byugs nas khru gang tsam brtsigs pa'i mthar g.yon skor du khrag gi mchod yon gnyis nas bzung bshos bu zur gsum gyi bar drag mchod kyis bskor ba'i mthar mtshams 'dzin bcas dang / snod ji ltar rigs par dug sna mi tshil bsres pa'i sha sna tshogs/ mu zi/ ldong ros/ 'bru nag gang 'dzom/ yungs dkar nag ke tshe/ shang tshe/ lcags phye/ zangs phye/ dri ngan chung ba'i phyir dug sba dang mu zi sogs rdzas byings rnams lhan cig sbyar ba'i ril bu bcu rdo tsam byas kyang chog thal chen rnams bsres la slob dpon kha lhor phyogs pa'i g.yas su bzhag g.yon du yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku sogs kyi drung du stegs kyi khar gtor bsngo dang bskong ba'i gtor ma rgyas bsdus ci rigs mchod pa bcas dang / lcog rtse sogs kyi khar rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru nang mchod 'thor nas/ phur pa/ gri gug gser skyems kyi chas rnams dang / mdun du lcags slang sogs kyi nang dgra bgegs kyi dri ma gang rnyed dang / mi mang po bsad pa'i sa/ g.yul bkye ba'i sa phung shul gyi sa sna gang 'dzoms ro thal rnams bag zan la bsres pa'i liṅga khru gang tsam gyi snying khar khrag gi ri mo mtheb tshigs tsam yod pa/ lces brang khebs shing lag pa snying khar bsnol nas bsdoms pa/ rkang pa gnyis gcig gis gcig mnan pa lcags sgrog gis bcings nas gan rkyal du bsgyel ba la gdong ras nag po bkab nas rdo rjes mnan pa bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni drug cu pa sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i brag rdzong ma'i bdag bskyed gtor bsngo bskang gso rgyas bsdus gang rigs bstod pa bcas grub nas/ rgyas par na slob dpon tshang ma'am/ bsdu na slob dpon drag chas su zhugs/

chos 'byung shing brtsegs la liṅga dang bcas pa la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las gnam lcags las grub pa'i rdo rje'i thab khung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba kha khyer la rdo rje dang me ri 'bar bskor ba'i nang du ye shes kyi me dpung dmar nag 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes bar gyi mgon po dang / de'i mdun du traṃ las nas/ hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa zhes pa'i bar gyi yum chen lha mo bcas dang / mgon po'i thugs ka nas yaṃ/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ spros pa las yum chen gyi g.yon nas bzung g.yas skor du gnod sbyin yab yum/ yab las tri tri dang / yum las bh+yoḥspros pa las pu tra ming sring gsum bskyed tshul rnams sa lo'i gsung rgyun zin bris gtor bsngo chen mo sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bskyed/ ra las ra skyes kyi steng du me lha dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis gri gug dang be con/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa khams nag gyen du brdzes shing / dar nag pos stod g.yogs dang / thod pa skam rlon dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang zhal nas 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog pa/ rngams shing gsod pa'i las la brtson pa/ gzhan yang phyogs kyi ru 'dren sde bzhi/ lha chen/ klu chen/ gshin rje/ ma mo/ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa dregs byed dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i mdun du khaṃ nag po las gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'brub khung nag po gru gsum pa/ rgya khyon rab tu yangs pa/ gting ring zhing zabs pa gser gyi sa la thug pa/ khrag mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs cing / dug nad sprin ltar gtibs pa/ me rlung dmar nag drag tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ mtshon cha'i ser chen 'bab cing /

thog gi bu yug 'tshubs pa/ srog bdud las kyi shan pa mang po dam nyams la rub cing skad sgra rdeb pa/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad stong gsum gang bas rgyob gsod 'jigs pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ thar med las kyi brtson khang nag la 'thib pa'i nang du/ nri ljang khu las dgra bo/ tri dkar po las pho gdon/ pri ser po las mo gdon rnams lus rid cing skra 'bal ba/ kha sna dang bshang gci'i chu lhug par 'chor ba/ rdul gyis mog mog por gyur cing mig gting du shor ba/ kha nas khrag 'dzag pa/ sna nas rnag dang / rna ba nas chu ser dang / mig nas mchi ma'i rgyun 'dzag pa/ shu ba dang / phol mig gis btab pa/ 'dar zhing skrag pas kye hud kyi ngud mo'i sgra 'byin pa/ sdug bsngal zhing nyam thag pa mgon skyabs dang bral ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ zhes sogs gtor bsngo sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod la/ sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i rjes su slob dpon gyis rdor dril g.yab dar thogs/ dad ring gi tshe rol mo kha bslang pa'i bar chung rnams la dril gsil bzhag dad ring dang swa ring gang yin kyang / rol mo dang bstun pa'i rnga g.yog phog mtshams rnams su g.yab pa'o// gzhan rnams kyis rnga rol rkang gling sogs kyi sgra rgya cher bya/ g.yab dar dang / gu gul/ tshil chen sogs kyi dud pa shin tu che ba sbyar la/ spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol rgyas pa dad ring ngam swa ring gang rung phyag len bzhin la dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol gyi mthar chems brdung gi rjes su gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la rnga rol bzhag mchod pa nas dam bzhag rdzogs pa'i bar gtor bsngo bzhin/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel zhing phyir byas tshe gtor ma gru gsum che ba zhig la gru gsum chung ba mdun dang g.yon du gsum gsum g.yas dang rgyab tu re re khrag smug gang rung gis byugs shing sha mar gyi rgyan dang /

gtor gdugs sngo nag gang rung ste/ dbus ma mgon po g.yon gsum yum lha mo gnod sbyin mo/ mdun du pu tra ming sring / g.yas nag po gnod sbyin dang / rgyab me lha rnams so/ bskang gtor rnams gsos la nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ lcam dral gyi gtor sngags kyi rjes su las mgon gyi gtor sngags kyang mthud la phul/ phyi mchod nang mchod phrin las 'chol rnams gtor bsngo bzhin bya/ de nas mgon po lcam dral las mgon sogs kyi bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de'i tshe rang nyid mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa lcags kyu'i rnam pa can rtse mo la dam rdzas mchod pa'i sprin spung bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang / 'khor gyi lha chen brgyad sogs phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba dang bcas pa la phog pas/ 'od zer gyis nang gi rtogs pa rgyas dam rdzas kyis phyi'i sku lus rgyas pas/ mgon po dang dregs byed thams cad bdag la rdo rje 'chang dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po dang bcas pas gang bsgo ba nyan cing / ci bsam sgrub pa'i rnam pa can du gyur te/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa dang / phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi snying kha nas 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pa nar gyis byung ste/ bdag gi hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la gdugs kyi rtsibs bzhin 'dus nas thim pas/ bdag la mgon po lcam dral dregs byed dang bcas pas srog snying phul bar bsams la/ de wa pi tsu dang / yi ge bdun ma/ bcu gnyis ma rnams 'phreng 'khor/ sha sa na drug cu/ lha mo'i ro ru lnga bcu/ las mgon mo'i rbod rbad gsad gsum ni/ ro ru tri tsa sogs 'bod pa/ trag rak+ṣa sogs rbad pa/ ma hā rak+ṣa sogs gsad pa rnams sbrel nas nyer lnga pho rbod rbad bsad gsum ni/

i li sogs bod pa/ dh+rig sogs rbad pa/ nṛ na sogs gsad pa rnams sbrel nas bcu gsum bzlas pa'i mthar ling khebs bsal/ gu gul gyis bdug dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i drag bskul dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin/ bse mgon/ lha mo/ pu tra'i drag bskul rnams phyag len bzhin byas pa'i mthar chems brdung gi rjes su gsum brdeg len can byas la gser skyems phyag len bzhin/ ru 'dren sgo ma sogs kyi 'chams byed na/ slob dpon kha lhor phyogs pa'i drung du sbyin sreg gi yo byad tshang ma bsham slob dpon gyi rnga rol pa rnams kha lhor phyogs par bsgrigs/ 'chams pa rnams byang nas 'thon/ rnga rol dang bcas pa mtha' nas bskor rang rang gi phyogs su bsgrigs/ sgo ma las mkhan rnams dkyil du bskor ba'i dbus su 'chams dpon pu tra bzhugs so/ /de'i rjes su dge slong nas bzung bskul dang 'chams rnams sngags 'chang chen po'i 'chams yig bzhin dpang gzugs sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rgyas bsdus kyi bar byas la/ de rdzogs mthar gsum brdeg len can byas la bzhag mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'dir mchan zhig yod kyang mi gsal/ liṅga slob dpon gyi phur bus bsgral ba sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ 'chams mi byed na gser skyems phul ba'i chems brdung mthar rol mo nyis brdeg tu bsgyur la/ kye bos ma'i dbyangs rol drug cu pa bzhin/ mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod kyi mthar/ dgu brdung gnyis kyi rjes su chems brdung la rkang gling g.yab dar bcas dang / 'jog mtshams gur drag mchod rol bzhin/ rang nyid kyis rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ thugs shin tu khros pa/ nam mkha' la 'phags cing / zhabs gnyis sa la drag tu brdabs pas/ zhabs 'og gi dgra bgegs nyal nyal pa/ khros pa'i spyan gsum phyogs thams cad la dmar hrig hrig gzigs shing / thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa rno zhing myur ba lcags bsregs mgar gyi sol mal nang nas byung ma thag pa lta bu'i me stag 'phro ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/

mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas la phog thugs rgyud drag tu bskul bas/ khro 'khrugs rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog cing 'jigs su rung bar gyur/ de dag dang rang gi thugs ka nas las mgon mdog nag cing mi sdug pa phud sgras stong gsum 'gengs shing lag tu lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog spu gri/ dam shing / ral gri/ mdung sogs mtshon cha dpag tu med pa thogs pa nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin du phyogs thams cad du 'phros te/ dgra bgegs gang yod kyi gnas nas bya spu rlung gis bskyod pa ltar rang dbang med par/ lcags kyus snying kha nas phug zhags pas sked pa nas bcings/ lcags sgrogs gis yan lag bsdams/ tho ba dang mtshon cha thogs pas rgyab nas brdung / mun pas mdun nas bsus/ las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded de/ liṅga'i steng du bkug cing phab par bsams la ngag tu/ dzaḥ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje la sogs pa yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyiྎ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'iྎ ma rungs pa tshar gcod dam can stobs 'phrog nag po yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa'iྎ gzhan yang dam can gnod sbyin yab yum bka' bstod pu tra ming sring / sprul pa'i ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dam nyams sdig can thams cad sa 'og sa steng / sa bla gar gnas kyang /

dgra bgegs kyi liṅga 'di nyid la myur du khug la/ myur du phob cig ces brjod la hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya phyogs thams cad du bskor zhing liṅga'i steng du phab ste/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya bcas shing / dril bu'i sgra drag tu sgrog go /de'i tshe rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa shin tu myur ba dmar zhing 'khrugs pa du ma dang / khro bo rlung gi shugs can dpag tu med pa 'phros/ gong du khro bo spros pa rnams kyis/ dgra bgegs rnams phyogs thams cad nas thib thib bkug nas 'ong ba rnams la reg pa tsam gyis skad cig nyid la bkug nas liṅga la sib ste thim par bsams la phyag rgya de dag gis rang gi don byas shing dril bu'i sgras brgyal ba lta bur gyur par bsam mo/ /de lta bu lan gsum mdzad cing / ngag tu oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sha truṃ bigh+nān a kar+ṣa ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gzhan gong dang 'dra ba la dam nyams sdig can thams cad srung bar byed pa'i lha dang / skyob par byed pa'i lha dang / 'go bar byed pa'i lha thams cad dang phrol cig oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sha truṃ bigh+nān sarba de wā rak+ṣa bi de sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i tshe rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa/ lcags sgrog gi rnam par 'phros kho bsrung skyob byed pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha dang bsrung 'khor la sogs pa la phog pas/ de dag oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam par sbyang / rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ de dag slar yang 'od zer me dang mtshon gyi rnam par 'phros te/ kho'i bsrung skyob byed pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad mtha'i lcags ri nag po'i bar du bskrad par bsam zhing gu gul gyis bdug cing / yungs dkar gyis brab/ phaṭa sgra dang bcas te/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / yi ge bdun ma brjod/ yungs dkar de dag lag na thogs ma thag lcag drag gi ser ba lta bur gyur te grogs kyi lus khrol mar gtang bar bsams nas dbab bo/

/de'i tshe srung ma rnams kyis dgra bgegs de nyid bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang nges nas sngon gyi dam bcas dran pas rab tu khros pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog cing seng ge sha la rngams pa ltar/ myur ba nyid du sgrol ba'i nyams can du bsams la/ rnga brdung zhing / dkon mchog gsum la dmod pa dang / /slob dpon la ni sdang ba dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang / /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi/ /byad 'di nas dbyangs brel du btang dang rbod stong byed pa dang / /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed pa yi/ /mi dang mi min gang yang rung / /nag po khyed kyis 'dir khug la/ /liṅga 'di la myur du chug /srung ba'i lha rnams kun dang 'phrol/ /mthu dang nus pa nyams par gyis/ 'dir rol mo/ /hūm̐ 'di yi spyi bor khyod 'dug la/ /til tsam ma lus gsol bar gyis/ /'di yi sha zo khrag la 'thung / /klad pa rus pa nang khrol zo/ /rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /mdza' ba kun dang 'phrol la thong / /'di nas dbyangs brel du btang / tshe srog chod la med par mdzod/ /bdag gi bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/ / bdun brdung rdzogs nas chems brdung gi rjes su gsum brdeg len can byas la bzhag de nas lcags phur lag tu blang / g.yon pas/ /a g.yas pa'i rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul/ mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las gsod byed las kyi mgon po sku stod khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri thod 'dzin pa/ rngams brjid drag shul dang ldan pas/ ha ha dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi nga ro sgrog pa/ lte ba man chad gnam lcags zhun ma las grub pa'i phur bu zur gsum pa/ gang yang thogs med du 'bigs pa'i rno dbal can du bsam/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas srid gsum gyi dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ gnyis med kyi rgyud thams cad kyi nus mthu thams cad thim par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ de nas shā sa na tshar gsum dang / ye dharma sogs tshang ma/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā ye badz+ra kī li kī la ya gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ye dhar dang phur sngags 'di tshar gcig phur pa khyed kyis khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la mnga' mdzod cig dgra bgegs byad ma myur du sgrol cig ces brjod la phur bu khrag chang dang / nyung dkar gtor phur bu lag tu bsgril zhing / 'di lan gsum gyi dang po la khrag gnyis pa la chang / gsum pa la yungs dkar phur sar gtor/ hūm̐ khros pa'i gzugs ldan gdug pa gang / /ji ltar rgyal bas mi 'dul ba/ /dam bcas ji bzhin sh+lau ka gsum po 'di la chos nyid ma'i bzlog dbyangs rol mo bcas sh+lau ka re re'i mtshams su rol mo byed/ 'chams tshul phur bzlog gi bdud rgyal bskul bzhin rjes ma'i dgu brdung 'then rkang rdzogs nas chems brdung gi ma mo liṅga bsgral/ rjes dgongs la/ /da lta nyid du 'dir khug cig /'bar ba me yi khung bu ru/ /rab tu bcings nas mnar ba yi/ /gzugs kyi snying khar phur bu me/ /nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i zur gsum dbal/ /rab tu bsnun no mnar ba'i sems/ /rnam par ma rig bral gyur nas/ nag po chen pos rjes su gzung / /sarba sha truṃ big+nān/ kī li kī la ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing phur pa liṅga'i snying khar btab pas tshe'i rgyun bcad/ sems kyi rten phral/ rnam shes ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po gzung 'dzin dang bral ba zhig phur dbal la 'khril te/ phur bu'i khong seng nas rgya mthongs nas bya 'phur ba bzhin rtser thon bdag nyid he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi shangs bug nas zhugs/

sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ thugs khar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ dhu ti'i lam dag pa nas yum gyi pad mar babs pa'i skad cig la he ru ka ye shes kyi sku can du gyur pa la mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas/ dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas 'ja' gur dang spos kyis gtibs shing rol mo dang me tog gi char dpag tu med pa dang bcas te/ skad cig de nyid la 'og min gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ g.yon gyis phur pa bzung g.yas kyi nyer spyod lnga'i phyag rgya dang ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gi bar brjod/ 'di la phur pa'i skabs bzhin liṅga'i snying khar gtsug bton du ma dang / phur rtse gyen la bstan pa sogs kyi dgos pa bsgril nas 'jug thengs gcig gis chog go /phaṭa/ drag po brjod cing / mig gyen du yun ring du blta/ rang gi sems dang bsgral bya'i sems/ sgrol byed kyi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa rnams ro gcig tu bsres nas 'dzin med blo 'das kyi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar mnyam par 'jog de nas las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i dgra bgegs kyi lus de nyid la srung ma rnams kyis mtshon dang khrag nad kyi char phab pas khrol tshags ltar phug par bsams la/ gri gug sogs mtshon chas liṅga dum bur gtubs/ mthar rol mo gsum brdeg ru 'dren rnams so so'i phyogs su langs/ sgo ma las mkhan rnams shing khri sug la slob dpon la zhal phyogs par khyel bzhugs log 'tshams ma ran bar bya/ len can byas la bzhag dug sna sogs gong gi rdzas ril bu sgril tshe rdog drug cu tsam rnams dang ling ro bsres la/ nang mchod gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa las grub pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsam/ 'bul ba la sdom nas 'bul ba dang /

so sor 'bul ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi g.yas g.yon du mchod g.yog pa gnyis langs la/ g.yas kyi mchod g.yog pas rdzas dang bsres pa'i ling ro nas thod pa sogs snod ji ltar rigs par dum tsam zhig blangs nas slob dpon la 'bul ba dang chabs cig skad gsangs mthon pos bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po 'di dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du brgya tham pa 'bul bar zhu zhes dang / slob dpon gyis snod blangs nas rdzas bsres pa'i ling ro 'bul ba dang chabs cig dpon slob thams cad kyis oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra ru tra bha ṭa ru lu rak+kha si/ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra sarba sha truṃ bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la/ g.yon gyi mchod g.yog pas grangs bzung / dgu bcu go dgu song ba dang 'bul ba brgya tham pa lags/ zhes brjod/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod phyag len ltar grub nas/ sangs rgyas bstan srung ma sh+lau ka gcig rang dbyangs bcas/ dpal ldan lha mo sh+lau ka gcig lam gru ma'i dbyangs rol/ nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ me lha ru 'dren la sogs pa/ bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ 'di la lha mchog nag po'i dbyangs rol rnams byas la rnga rol/ bzhag gnyis pa so sor 'bul ba ni/ yang g.yas kyi mchod g.yog pas rdzas bsres pa'i ling ro dum tsam zhig 'bul ba dang chabs cig bdag cag nas/ phung po 'di zhes pa'i bar gong ltar la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i zhal du brgya tham pa 'bul ba lags/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis oṃ ma hā kā la ya sarba sha truṃ sogs gong bzhin dang / g.yon gyi mchod g.yog pas grangs 'dzin tshul gong bzhin/

oṃ ma hā kā la ya sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ma hā rak+ta sa mu tra nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i mthar/ mchod rol dung bcas gur drag bzhin dang / rkang gling gdangs gcig ma bskang so shur ma sogs byed pa bzhin/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin la/ dam nyams dgra bo'i srog gcod nag po che/ /ma hā kā la khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i rjes su gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa bya tshul phur pa'i nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ma sogs sh+lau ka re 'dur ma byas pa'i mthar byed tshul bzhin/ yang g.yas kyi mchod g.yog pas ling ro 'bul ba dang chabs cig bdag cag sogs gong bzhin la/ yum chen e ka dza ṭī dang / dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i zhal du brgya tham pa 'bul ba lags/ ces dang / dpon slob rnams kyis oṃ ma hā ma tri ma hā kā li de wī ye sarba sha truṃ sogs dang / g.yon gyi mchod g.yog pas grangs 'dzin bcas gong bzhin/ ma hā ma tri sogs sngon 'gro'i rak+ta'i yon chab nas rol mo dang nang mchod kyi bar gong bzhin phul/ bh+yoḥ kun tu bzang po'i rig ma las/ /ma g.yos u ma de wā'i sku/ /ma mo thams cad bskyed mdzad ma/ /yum chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing / /ye shes sku gcig 'gying zhing khro/ /g.yu yi ral pas srid gsum sgrol/ /snyan gnyis 'gro drug gsol 'debs gsan/ /shangs kyi rlung sgras bag chags 'joms/ /skye shi rtsad gcod mche ba gtsigs/ /spyan gsum 'gro la gzigs shing bzhad/ /thar pa'i lam ston gsung dbyangs snyan/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag gnyis kyis/ /g.yu yi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin/ /tshe 'dzin bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams/ /skye 'gro gso ba'i yum gcig ma/ /e ka dza ṭi dpal dang ldan/ /yum chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs la gang sku ma'i dbyangs rol dang /

lha mo'i bstod pa gang sku ma'i dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin la/ 'gro kun dbang du bsdu bar mdzad kyi mthar gsum brdeg len can gong bzhin/ yang g.yas kyi mchod g.yog pas ling ro 'bul ba dang chabs cig bdag cag sogs gong bzhin la/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum gyi zhal du sogs dang / dpon slob rnams kyis badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa ka li yak+ṣi ṇi sarba sha truṃ sogs dang / g.yon phyogs nas grangs 'dzin tshul dang / mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nang mchod 'bul ba'i bar 'dra/ gnod sbyin gyi 'gyings dbyangs bu sdug bzhin du rtag tu bsrung skyob mdzod kyi mthar/ gsum brdeg len can gong bzhin/ yang g.yas kyi mchod g.yog pas ling ro 'bul ba dang chabs cig bdag cag sogs gong bzhin la/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring sogs/ dpon slob rnams kyis yak+ṣa pu tra rū tra bha ṭa ru lu rak+kha si sarba sha truṃ sogs dang / g.yon nas grangs gsog tshul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nang mchod 'bul ba'i bar 'dra/ pu tra ming sring gsum gyi bstod pa'i dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin la/ gsang sngags rnal 'byor skyong ba'i phrin las mdzod kyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can gong bzhin/ yang g.yas kyi mchod g.yog pas ling ro 'bul ba dang chabs cig bdag cag sogs gong bzhin la/ drag po me lha'i zhal du song / dpon slob rnams kyis oṃ ag+na ye sarba sha truṃ sogs dang g.yon nas grangs gsog tshul/ mtshan sngags kyis nang mchod 'bul ba'i bar gong 'dra las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /sh+lau ka gcig la gang thugs ma'i dbyangs rol/ tshangs pa 'jig rten nas rnga brdung 'dur ma/ de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal gyi mthar sum brdeg len can gong bzhin/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje thogs mchod g.yog g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis mtshams mtshams su gser skyems dang khrag gtor/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ hoḥ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon 'gro mgon bka'i srung ma'i tshogs/

gzhan yang pha mes gnyan gyi srung ma/ dben gnas gnyen gyi srung ma/ brten brten/ bsgrub bsgrub/ gsol gsol/ mchod mchod pa/ sku dang grib ma ltar gnas pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gang na gnas pa na/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gang na gnas pa na/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no/ /gsang ba'i snying po gang na gnas pa na/ sngags bdag dregs pa'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no/ /chos skyong bstan pa mi bsrung ci zhig srung / /dam can dam la mi gnas ci la gnas/ /sngags bdag dgra bgegs mi sgrol ci zhig sgrol/ /su la mi re khyod la re/ /su la mi ltos khyod la ltos/ /rgyal mtshan du khyed 'dzugs/ phrag pa la khyed khur/ dmag dpung du khyed bskyed/ dpa' dar du khyed 'phyar ba yin pas/ sngon gyi dam tshig las ma 'da' bar/ sdang byed dgra la mthu ma chung / gnod byed dgra bgegs la rtsal ma zhan/ bcol pa'i las la bang ma bul/ mthu dang rtsal ma zhan/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig yul khyim dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod cig mi nor phyugs gsum gyi gnyer mdzod cig yul du 'khor srungs shig byes su rkyen bzlog cig phyi nang gi bar chad srungs shig bcol pa'i las gyis shig sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig 'phrin las mngon du gyis shig rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa yid bzhin du bsgrub par mdzod cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang dmod pa/ snga dgra dar ba/ phyi dgra sems pa/ da dgra brtsams pa/ gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs/ bstan pa bshig par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams thal ba rdul du rlog cig bdag gi kha yis ma nyes/ lag gis ma nyes/ spyod pas ma nyes/ khos sku la bsdos so/ /rigs la bsnyags so/ /bstan pa bshig go /'di las kyi rlung dmar gyis rgyab nas phul cig

'jigs pa'i mun nag gis mdun nas sus shig gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas chod cig sa yi rten phur 'og nas phyung zhig dkon pa'i tshe srog dang phrol cig tshe'i 'du byed skums shig kha ru lag pa chug cig khong nas snying dmar phyungs shig mig 'bras thang la lhung zhig 'chi bdag gi bdud thongs shig 'khor shig tshang dkrugs shig mgo bo khos shig lus skems shig sgo'i nor dang phrol cig mchan gyi bu dang phrol cig yul dang khang khyim shigs cig zhing gi skye rgyud chod cig yar gyi pha rgyud chod cig mar gyi bu rgyud chod cig rtsad nas chod cig drungs nas phyungs shig glo bur dang ye 'drog thong zhig smyo 'bog dang brgyal nad thongs shig ltas ngan dang cho 'phrul thongs shig mna' bsnol dang dme 'khrug thongs shig lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig zhag dang za ma la rtags mtshan phyungs shig nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ 'jig rten phyi ma la dus ma 'debs/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i skye shi la khungs ma 'byin/ las kyi dbang btsan no zhes tha snyad ma 'dogs par/ rtags dang mtshan ma myur du mngon phyungs shig khyed la gtang rag dang mchod gtor gnyan po gtong ngo / /ye shes kyi spyan 'byed do/ /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul lo/ /bcol pa'i las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod cig ces brjod/ shā sa na dang las mkhan gyi rbod rbad bsad gsum 'ur 'don bya zhing rol mo drag tu dkrol/ rkang gling dang bcas pa'i mthar 'jog mtshams gur drag mchod rol bzhin/ he ru ka'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs bzod gsol/ gtor bsngo sogs kyi mjug bzhin thab nang gi ye shes pa lha brgyad kyi bris sku sogs yod na de'i thugs kar bstims pa'am/ yang na gong bzhin mdun bskyed la bstim/ de dag gi tshig ni/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa dang / thab nang gi ye shes pa rnams oṃ khyed kyis spyi 'gre/ bris 'bur gyi sku med na thab nang gi mgon po lha brgyad rang la thim/

rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa dang / me lha ru 'dren sogs dregs byed kyi 'khor rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs gong bzhin dang dam tshig pa rang la thim/ gong du 'chams byas pa yin na rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes brjod la rnga rol rkang gling dang bcas pa ru 'dren las mkhan rnams kyi log 'chams rdzogs nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gur gyi mgon po 'grub gyur nas sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sogs/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi 'gre byas la/ nyin mo bde legs kyi mchod rol rdzogs nas/ sbyin sreg phyi rol du byas pa yin na/ slob dpon gyi 'chams bcams la phur pa'i rtsa 'chams kyi log 'chams rdo rje'i 'gros kyis log go /'di mgon po la mi 'gal te rdo rje'i 'gros ni gsang sngags spyir btang ba yin pas so/ /gong du 'chams med na gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs rgyun bzhin no/ /zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg rgyas par bya tshul 'di yang 'dam thog bla ma mdo sngags rab 'byams pa bstan pa yar 'phel nas 'di bzhin dgos tshul bskul ma byung don bzhin sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mgon po'i sbyin sreg dug me'i 'khor lo la gzhi byas/ der mi gsal ba rnams sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i yig cha tshad thub so so nas kha bskangs/ dbyangs rol 'chams sogs byed tshul sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab sras kyi phyag len la mdzad pa bzhin gdan sa chen po na rgyun ma nyams par bzhugs pa dag gis brgyan te bkod pa yin pas sbyin sreg 'di bzhin gzhan gyis nyams su len tshe dbyangs rol 'chams rnams mgon po'i chos skor sa lugs mthun phyin so so'i phyag len bzhin nyams su blangs pas don 'grub par sbyar ba 'di'i dge bas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/
